Indian Swimmer Deported from Japan Over Sexual Misconduct Allegations

Indian para swimmer Mohammad Shams Alam Shaikh has been deported from Japan following allegations of sexual misconduct. The incident occurred while he was in Japan for the Asian Para Games. He was reportedly detained and subsequently deported due to misconduct with hotel staff.
